name: Tayny Rozhdestva
source:
Christmas is a beautiful, radiant holiday—a time for exchanging gifts and gathering with family and loved ones. But what if you can’t remember who those loved ones are—or even if you have any at all? You don’t even remember who *you* are.

Waking up in the middle of a snow-covered plain, Heldra realizes she has no idea how she got there or what actually happened to her. Yet standing knee-deep in the snow is no time for despair; she needs to find help. And who better to turn to in such a mysterious situation than the guardians of the sacred Christmas tree?

However, all is not well in their home, and deep within the forest, an ancient enemy is stirring from its slumber...

[Translated from [url=https://roudark.itch.io/christmasmystery]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
圣诞节本是美好而璀璨的节日——一个互赠礼物、与家人及挚爱团聚的温馨时刻。可倘若你根本记不起自己所爱之人是谁——甚至不确定自己是否拥有亲人呢？你甚至连自己究竟是谁都想不起来了。

在白雪皑皑的荒原中央醒来后，海尔德拉发现自己完全不知道是怎么来到这里的，也记不清身上究竟发生过什么。然而站在没膝深的积雪里绝非自暴自弃的时候，她必须尽快寻求帮助。面对如此离奇的处境，还有谁比神圣圣诞树的守护者们更值得求助呢？

然而守护者们的家园同样暗流涌动，而在森林最深处，一尊古老的宿敌正从漫长的沉睡中悄然苏醒……
